page.help: Let members apply for a role, like moderator, by answering a few questions with /apply in Discord. Staff read the answers and approve or deny. Approving gives the role.

submitted.help: Applications waiting for a decision. Approving gives the role. Either way, the member gets a private message (DM) with the result, and the staff log message is updated. You can also do this with /app-admin review in Discord.
submitted.question: Q{number}: {question}
submitted.noteHelp: Sent to them with the decision, for example why.
submitted.confirm: Send this decision to {name}? They get a private message (DM).
submitted.none: No applications are waiting for review.
submitted.needsAdmin: To review applications here you need the Administrator permission in this server.

roles.title: Applications ({count})
roles.help: The roles members can apply for with /apply. Each one has its own questions, or uses the default questions below.
roles.name: Name
roles.nameHelp: What members see in /apply, for example Moderator.
roles.openHelp: Off: members cannot apply for this role right now.
roles.logChannelHelp: Where new applications for this role are posted for staff.
roles.questionsHelp: One question per line, up to {max}. Leave empty to use the default questions. Add [min:10] at the end of a question to ask for an answer of at least 10 characters.
roles.deleteText: Deleting also removes every application members sent for {name}. The next page shows how many, and you confirm there.

settings.title: Settings
settings.help: Setting the log channel here also changes the Applications log channel on the Logging page, and the other way round.
settings.logChannelHelp: Where new applications are posted for staff to review.
settings.pendingDaysHelp: Applications nobody has decided on are deleted after this long.
settings.reviewedDaysHelp: Approved and denied applications are deleted after this long.

questions.title: Default questions
questions.help: Used for every role that has no questions of its own.
questions.label: Default questions
questions.labelHelp: One question per line, up to {max}. Add [min:10] at the end of a question to ask for an answer of at least 10 characters.

managers.title: Manager roles
managers.help: Members with these roles can read and decide applications, without being administrators.

confirm.heading: Confirm: delete the {name} application
confirm.effectText: The application is removed from /apply and every application members sent for it is deleted. This cannot be undone. The role itself stays.

action.noteTooLong: The note is limited to {max} characters.
action.roleNotGiven: The role could not be given (check my Manage Roles permission and the role order).
action.reviewedGiven: Application of {name} for {role} {status}. The role was given.
action.emptyName: The application name cannot be empty.
action.roleGone: That application role no longer exists.
action.notManager: That role is not a manager role.
